generate_doxygen_xml: run doxygen to generate XML documentation files for the pybind11 C++ header files
prepare: copy and preprocess the README.rst file for inclusion in the Sphinx documentation build
clean_up: remove the generated readme.rst file after the Sphinx documentation build finishes
setup: register Sphinx builder hooks to generate Doxygen XML, prepare the readme, and clean up after the build
review_conf: review the Sphinx conf.py configuration for extensions, Breathe Doxygen integration, and HTML theme settings
